title: ComingSoonState
wrapsNative: VStack of MonarchBadge, MonarchEmptyState (ContentUnavailableView) and Label rows
summary: A recipe, not a component: an empty state that says a feature is planned, with a "Coming soon" badge, what the feature will do, what is planned and an optional "Notify me" action.
whenToUse: In a tab, a card or a screen for a feature that is announced but not available yet.
whenNotToUse: For a feature the person has no access to, use MonarchErrorState with the forbidden kind. For an empty list of a feature that exists, use MonarchEmptyState.

states.name: with an action
states.description: MonarchEmptyState draws a button when actionTitle and action are given, such as "Notify me".

states.name: without a feature name
states.description: Use "Coming soon" as the empty state's title and leave the badge out.

appearance: An info-toned subtle badge with a clock above the standard empty state (icon, title, message, button), followed by muted body rows with check marks for what is planned.
platformNotes: The web ComingSoonState is a component with fixed "Coming soon" wording, the badge read as part of the heading, and a highlights list. On iOS it composes existing parts: MonarchEmptyState has no slot for a badge or a list, so they sit above and below it. The app supplies the wording, so Monarch ships no strings for it. Android shares the recipe approach.
accessibility: The badge is read before the title, as "Coming soon", then the title with the header trait.
The empty state's icon is decorative; its button has a 44-point touch target.
Each planned item is a Label read as its text; the check mark is part of the label and not a state.
edgeCases: Keep the planned list to three or four lines; it does not scroll on its own.
Change the button title after the person asks to be notified, so the screen confirms it.
